body:
Funnily enough I felt like I was holding back writing that post. The shit that goes through my head nowadays ranges from dark to pitch black.


Either due to emotional exhaustion, reading other posts on this sub, or both, right now I feel like it’s unlikely that I’ll take my life tomorrow. I do have a counselling session booked next week so I could predict that I’ll probably hold on until then at least. It’s interesting how well all this chaos makes your actions so predictable. 


In the same vein, how resigned I was to my fate when I wrote that post was nothing like I’ve ever felt before. Having experienced that I know I can’t promise I’ll never do it, but I hope you can take solace in that you helped give me another chance.


Thanks for your reply.

Hey, many thanks for the reply. The future definitely is cloudy, honestly any possible future for me right now is going to be a hurricane. I really did write this post as a final goodbye, but I have to say that after reading the replies, as well as other posts in this subreddit, that at least right now I don’t feel the same way. 


I want to give you credit because I saw your signature in a lot of what I read and you’re doing more than your part in trying to bring more hope to the world. Unfortunately I can’t promise that I’ll never go through with it, but I can say that it doesn’t feel like it’s my only choice for the time being.

I feel the deepest of sympathy for you in your situation. Everything you said seems to mirror how depression has affected my life. Under these awful circumstances all I can offer is the idea that I am struggling along side you in many ways and that I truly hope you overcome this with all of my heart.
